scope: New acceptance runner entry points only; complements historical leaf audit. Integrity is not execution or production acceptance. Labels are the union of implemented modes; actual selected per-check reports take precedence.

runners.scope: Isolated UI interactions and persisted effects; optional native devices, capture, model and external skill execution.
modes: --external: two consecutive actual cloud UI sends on the same page, exact replies, durable transcript run IDs and restart/replay recovery
--models: actual UI assignment, isolated settings restart and independently observed real upstream model request; provider-reported alias retained separately
--providers: actual UI provider create/edit/delete with isolated persisted files, credential preservation and process restart; no service-execution claim
--provider-probe: UI-triggered real external model-list retrieval, not inference acceptance

--gguf: actual GGUF catalog, UI settings and namespaced model assignment with restart-visible active state and actual config export/import/restart, removal, source SHA preservation and failed mount; no chat inference claim
--gguf-runtime (requires --gguf; REAL_OS): actual selected model UI load, native-token self-test and unload; no local chat routing or semantic readiness claim
--agent-models: actual specialist UI assignment with restart persistence and unchanged coordinator defaults; no inference claim
--agent-execution (requires --agent-models; REAL_EXTERNAL): actual assigned specialist read_file, independent upstream model observation and parent consolidation
--parallel-agents (requires --agent-execution): two UI-assigned external models, overlapping independent file subtasks and both results in consolidation
--agent-recovery (requires --parallel-agents): actual external response held, host kill/restart, same-child resume and model pin despite changed settings; other selected checks may still fail
--model-import: real UI import/export, private round-trip preservation, invalid batch rejection and killed-writer startup recovery
--external-plugins: actual executable MCP package lifecycle and UI chat tool effect
--plugin-crash (requires --external-plugins; REAL_OS): owned process kill, rendered unavailable status and actual effect after UI restart
--devices
--external-skills
--skill-execution (requires --external-skills)
--screen
--screen-recall (requires --screen; REAL_OS + REAL_EXTERNAL)
--gguf-chat (requires --gguf-runtime; REAL_OS): actual main UI local inference, selected-model identity and persisted reply; exact city-only outcome enforced, selected-model failures retained
--gguf-tools (requires --gguf-runtime; REAL_OS): actual UI local write_file request, exact independent disk effect and persisted verified tool result; absent effects FAIL even if chat returns success
--gguf-qwen (requires --gguf): select separately provisioned pinned official Qwen weights for the same actual UI chat/tool acceptance; no mock response or relaxed assertions

--gguf-recall (requires --gguf-tools; REAL_OS): second actual UI user turn must return exact independently computed prior tool-result SHA256 without new tool calls, persist answer and retain selected model
--chat-abort (requires --external): actual provider text delta, real UI Stop click, cancelled task/interrupted persisted partial and next exact UI reply
--hf-search: actual official metadata, pinned identity, real bytes, modal close/reopen and settled cancellation through existing UI; no completion/inference claim

--hf-complete: actual UI external full transfer, independent disk SHA, immediate parent catalog refresh, real host restart/persisted catalog and actual UI native load/token-generation/unload; no semantic chat/tool accuracy claim

runners.scope: Actual duration/capture/OCR/resource measurements; optional local GGUF. Short runs never prove 24 hours; overall resource coverage remains partial.
modes: --hours N
--duration-seconds N
--local-vision 1

runners.scope: Native desktop fixture capture, OCR, change detection and reopened observation memory; not continuous endurance.
Owned host real-model/tool crash recovery, retries and failure outcomes; not arbitrary side-effect compensation.
modes: default: actual process kill/restart/resume
--retry-only
--tool-recovery-only
--tool-failure-only
--tool-unrelated-only

runners.scope: Owned isolated host and historical phase11 assertions; controlled connector fixtures are not external service execution.
Actual downloaded executable MCP plugin handlers, manager persistence, refresh, preparation-failure preservation, process kill/restart and file effects; UI covered separately.
Pinned GitHub skill executes actual model/tools and independent Chrome artifact interactions.
modes: default: new execution
--resume-directory DIR: existing artifact recheck only, not new execution

runners.scope: Controlled visible native screen changes and local GGUF inference persisted in encrypted observations.
Actual local GGUF generation, rendered color recognition, owned-process resources, cancellation and restart.
Actual observed title transition through configured rule to native screen-size action; not every OS event source.
Real point-in-time capture/native/OCR process counters; not whole-duration resource acceptance.
Read-only original row-content comparison against a specified actual backup; clock fields explicitly scoped.
modes: --backup DIR

runners.scope: Windows synthesized prompt to actual STT, configured model and TTS; not human spoken conversation.
modes: --devices: actual microphone frames and output playback; audibility/barge-in remain unverified
